svg.aria-label: State representation at 1.Nh3 d5 2.c4 Qd6 3.Qa4+, Black to move: what Black sees, four of the ten boards Black cannot tell apart, the probability board that averages them, and the 32 input planes it becomes.

g.text: (d) Network input: the probability board as 32 planes of 8×8
(e) One plane from four of the groups, with the values the network reads (blank = 0)
Only on squares we see: c4, h2.
Our pieces they see: d5 1, e8 .1.
Constant planes: belief size .22 (log2 10 / 15), ply .025, our kingside castling 1, the enemy's .9 (lost on the Rg1 board).
Planes are drawn as the board; for Black the network gets each plane flipped top to bottom.
Network output here: 3...d4 0.25 · dxc4 0.21 · Nf6 0.20 · c6 0.08 · Nc6 0.07. It plays d4; of these, only c6 and Nc6 block the check on the true board.
